events.name: Enemy Patrol
events.description: Enemies are moving through the dungeon.

choices.label: Engage Patrol
choices.description: Draw the enemies into a fight.

choices.label: Avoid Patrol
choices.description: Slip around the patrol and lower pressure slightly.

events.name: Abandoned Treasure Cart
events.description: A half-hidden cache waits in the dark.

choices.label: Take Supplies
choices.description: Gain moderate unsecured loot.

choices.label: Search Deeper
choices.description: Gain better unsecured loot at higher risk.

choices.label: Collapse Tunnel
choices.description: Gain no loot, but reduce future reinforcements.

events.name: Cracked Shrine
events.description: Old power gathers around a damaged shrine.

choices.label: Receive Blessing
choices.description: Choose one temporary boon.

choices.label: Cleanse Corruption
choices.description: Reduce pressure.

choices.label: Sacrifice Loot
choices.description: Lose unsecured loot to choose a stronger boon.

events.name: Pressure Plate
events.description: The room is wired with old mechanisms.

choices.label: Force Through
choices.description: Accept the danger and move quickly.

choices.label: Disarm Carefully
choices.description: Take your time and avoid the penalty.

choices.label: Trigger Intentionally
choices.description: Raise pressure to reveal a hidden opportunity.

events.name: Explosive Storage
events.description: Unstable goblin blasting powder is stacked against a support beam.

choices.label: Loot Powder Cache
choices.description: Secure extra loot, but the noise raises the alarm.

choices.label: Save Explosives
choices.description: Save explosives for the boss fight.

choices.label: Collapse Tunnel
choices.description: Reduce reinforcements and reveal a safer passage.

events.name: Captured Miner
events.description: A miner is trapped behind a crude goblin barricade.

choices.label: Save Miner
choices.description: Free the miner and earn an optional mastery objective.

choices.label: Use Miner Route
choices.description: Take the miner's hidden route.

events.name: Bound Spirit
events.description: A restless spirit clings to the old burial stones.

choices.label: Cleanse Spirit
choices.description: Lower the curse and mark the tomb as cleansed.

choices.label: Bind Power
choices.description: Gain a boon, but risk an ambush.

events.name: Cursed Reliquary
events.description: A sealed reliquary hums with a cold promise.

choices.label: Open Reliquary
choices.description: Claim stronger loot and accept the curse.

choices.label: Seal Reliquary
choices.description: Deny the relic and weaken the final shade.
